paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper presents X-ray line search with eROSITA eFEDS data, constraining decaying DM. ALP-photon coupling g_agamma limits shown in Fig 7 vs mass 2-18 keV (y-axis 1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1). The paper also constrains sterile neutrino mixing angle. Data points are approximate readings from the eFEDS limit curve in Fig 7 (not a numerical table); precise values are uncertain. DM density assumed rho_sun = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 with NFW profile. Caγγ=0.75 (DFSZ) used. 95% CL upper limit.
